item.title: Beijing Imperial Capital Tour
Xi'an Ancient Capital & Terracotta Army
item.description:
Tour Overview

Journey to Xi’an, the starting point of the Silk Road and home to the incredible Terracotta Army. This 4-day tour immerses you in ancient Chinese history while enjoying modern comforts.

Quick Facts

  • Duration: 4 days / 3 nights
  • Price: From $980 per person
  • Difficulty: Easy
  • Best time: March-June, September-November
  • Group size: 2-12 travelers

Itinerary Highlights

Day 1: Arrival & City Wall

  • Airport transfer and hotel check-in
  • Cycle or walk on the Ancient City Wall
  • Explore the Muslim Quarter
  • Dinner featuring Shaanxi cuisine

Day 2: Terracotta Army

  • Full-day visit to the Terracotta Army Museum
  • Private tour with archaeology expert
  • Visit the tomb of Emperor Qin Shi Huang
  • Evening Tang Dynasty music and dance show

Day 3: Historical Xi’an

  • Visit Big Wild Goose Pagoda
  • Shaanxi History Museum
  • Calligraphy lesson with local master
  • Free evening for shopping or relaxation

Day 4: Departure

  • Visit local market for souvenirs
  • Transfer to airport for departure

Book Your Ancient Adventure

Contact us to experience the wonders of ancient China.
